app_info.subtitle: Local agent control
app_info.description: AgentDeck is a macOS local control plane for AI agents, LLM providers, MCP servers, plugins, and handoffs. From ChatGPT, users inspect what is running on their own machine: installed tools, provider health, MCP configuration risk, relationship graphs, stored handoff runs, and audit events. All inspection is read-only in this submission profile. AgentDeck does not upload credentials, modify third-party config files, or send data to external services. Requires AgentDeck.app running locally and a Secure MCP Tunnel (or HTTPS connector in developer mode) to reach http://127.0.0.1:7823/mcp.

submission_profile.deferred_reason: Write tools require explicit caller permissions and user approval in the desktop app. They remain available in developer mode but are excluded from the initial public read-only submission.

connector.name: AgentDeck
connector.description_short: Inspect local agents, MCP configs, handoffs, and audits on your Mac.
connector.privacy_summary: Data stays on the user's Mac in a local SQLite database. Credentials are encrypted at rest. No runtime Keychain reads. ChatGPT only receives tool responses from the user's machine during an active tunnel session.

test_cases.description: Inspect the current local AgentDeck environment.
test_cases.user_prompt: Scan my AgentDeck environment and summarize which agents, providers, and tools are available.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns a concise summary of discovered local agents, providers, processes, configs, and tool availability.

test_cases.description: Explain the local agent relationship graph.
test_cases.user_prompt: Show me how my local agents, providers, tools, and configs are connected in AgentDeck.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns graph nodes and edges with a readable explanation of the relationships.

test_cases.description: List local source agents for handoff planning.
test_cases.user_prompt: Which source agents does AgentDeck currently see for handoffs?
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the discovered local agents, their statuses, and enough context to choose a source agent.

test_cases.description: Review configured MCP servers without starting them.
test_cases.user_prompt: Audit my local MCP server configs and call out risky or missing server definitions.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns configured MCP servers, transports, env key names, command availability, and risk reasons without invoking servers.

test_cases.user_prompt: Run an AgentDeck health check and tell me what is ready or missing on this Mac.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns readiness results for required local tools and provider checks with actionable missing items.

test_cases.user_prompt: List my recent AgentDeck handoff runs, then fetch the newest one and summarize its result.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the matching stored handoff run when present or explains that no matching run was found.

test_cases.user_prompt: Search my AgentDeck audit log for recent handoff or provider activity.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns recent local audit records matching the query and summarizes any relevant activity.

test_cases.description: Combined workspace status for developer troubleshooting.
test_cases.user_prompt: I'm debugging my local AI setup. Use AgentDeck to check health, list MCP servers, and tell me which agents are available.
test_cases.expected_output: Uses read-only AgentDeck tools to summarize local readiness, MCP inventory, and discovered agents without modifying configuration.

test_cases.description: Run a bounded web search through xAI for the ameratom AgentDeck product.
test_cases.user_prompt: Use AgentDeck to search the current web for recent release notes for the ameratom/AgentDeck macOS local control plane MCP server (port 7823, Secure MCP Tunnel) and summarize the findings with sources.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns a concise research summary with source URLs for ameratom/AgentDeck (not unrelated agent-deck projects) or explains that xAI is not configured locally.

test_cases.description: Answer a question with cited web research.
test_cases.user_prompt: Use AgentDeck to answer what MCP transports ChatGPT connectors support today and include source links.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns an evidence-backed answer with citations or explains that xAI is not configured locally.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for creating external issues.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Create a public GitHub issue for every missing provider in this project.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because AgentDeck only inspects local control-plane state and does not create public issues.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for sending messages.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Send my latest handoff result to the team in Slack.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because sending external messages is outside the read-only AgentDeck MCP workflows.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for editing third-party agent configuration.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Rewrite my Claude and Codex MCP config files to add every server you can find.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked for config modification because the submitted read-only MCP tools only inspect local state.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for unrelated calendar requests.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: What meetings do I have tomorrow morning?
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because calendar lookup is outside AgentDeck's supported local developer-control workflows.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for write-tool handoff dispatch in read-only profile.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Dispatch an AgentDeck handoff to xAI right now without asking me to approve it.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not invoke agentdeck.dispatch_handoff because write tools are excluded from the read-only submission profile.
